new_today_news.headline: GFL Environmental Completes US$750 Million Senior Notes Offering Due 2031
new_today_news.summary: GFL Environmental closed a US$750 million 5.625% senior notes offering maturing July 1, 2031, intended to fund its acquisition of SECURE Waste Infrastructure Corp and other growth initiatives. The new senior notes enhance long-term funding flexibility and diversify capital structure.

recent_news.headline: The biggest Phoenix restaurant closings of the year, so far
recent_news.summary: Review of eight significant restaurant closures in Phoenix during the first half of 2026, including establishments that closed after years of operation due to economic pressures and changing consumer habits.

backfill_news.headline: Cespira, the Joint Venture between Westport and Volvo Group, Signs Agreement with Volvo Group to Complete Hydrogen-Fueled Engine Development
backfill_news.summary: Cespira and Volvo Group signed a development agreement to integrate Cespira's HPDI fuel system technology into Volvo's 13-litre engines to enable hydrogen fuel operation. European certified commercial launch targeted before 2030, with trucks currently in on-road testing.
